marketing_description: The DeWALT DCB205C Battery and Charger Starter Kit includes a single 20 V MAX battery with a 5 Ah capacity and Lithium-Ion chemistry, paired with a 100 W-hr Energy Rating rapid charger. This kit is designed for use with DeWALT 20 V MAX tools and features a compact, durable construction for rugged use. The kit also includes a 3-year limited warranty.
